recipe.visualDefinition: A wide-angle landscape photograph of a group of people seated on a grassy, wildflower-covered cliff overlooking a deep blue ocean with white-capped waves. The composition is split horizontally between the textured, warm-toned foreground and the cool, expansive water background.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm yellow-brown foreground vs. cool blue background
Small-scale human figures against a vast natural landscape
White typography integrated into the bright sky/water horizon
Diagonal line of the cliff edge cutting through the frame
coreInvariants: High-angle perspective looking down at the cliff and out to sea

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The human group is positioned in the mid-ground, right-of-center, appearing relatively small compared to the environment.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The woman in the bright red dress acts as a saturated focal point against the muted landscape.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the red dress, moves up to the group, then follows the horizon line to the typography in the top right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Large areas of the ocean and the foreground meadow provide significant breathing room.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Ochre, mustard, and earthy browns (cliffside vegetation)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant crimson red (clothing) and crisp white (foam and text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between white foam and dark water; high saturation in the red accent.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon or modern digital colors

letterConstructionRules: Primary title uses a tall, condensed serif with varying stroke widths
Secondary text uses a fluid, italicized script with looping descenders
characterSpecificRedesigns: Oversized capital 'O' in the main title
Interlocking or tightly kerned characters in the display text
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A formal, condensed serif paired with a casual, handwritten-style script for a 'folk' feel.
graphicDevices: Small circular logo in the bottom left corner

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the tall, decorative serif feel of the era

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a wide-angle 1970s film-style photograph of a rocky coastal cliff covered in yellow and brown wildflowers. In the mid-ground right, a group of five people in vintage 70s clothing (one in a long red dress) sit on chairs. The background is a deep blue ocean with white waves crashing against rocks.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add white text in the top right corner. Use a tall, condensed high-contrast serif for the main title and a smaller, italicized script in quotes directly beneath it. Align all text to the right.

verificationChecks: Is the red dress the primary color pop?
Is the horizon line straight but the cliff edge diagonal?
Is the typography crisp white against the blue water?

adjustableVariables: Density of wildflowers in the foreground
Number of people in the group
Intensity of the blue in the ocean
mustRedesign: Exact wording of the original titles
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text does not obscure the people
Verify the transition between the cliff and the water looks natural
Confirm the typography uses two distinct but complementary styles
recipe.reuseFormula: Coastal landscape + 1970s group portrait + right-aligned high-contrast serif typography.
